description: Source file defining the NodeRuntime class for handling gateway connections, session management, and associated components within the ai.openclaw.app Android project. It includes networking, user interface actions, token management, and event handling logic.

classes.name: NodeRuntime
classes.description: Main class managing gateway connections, user sessions, event handling, and integration with various device and UI components within the Android app.

methods.name: resolveNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Generates a main session key based on device ID and optional agent ID.

methods.name: resolveMainSessionKey
methods.description: Returns the trimmed main session key or a default value if empty.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnConnect
methods.description: Resets canvas state to prepare for a new connection.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnDisconnect
methods.description: Resets canvas state upon disconnection.

methods.name: refreshHomeCanvasOverviewIfConnected
methods.description: Refreshes agent and branding info if connected; otherwise updates state.

methods.name: requestCanvasRehydrate
methods.description: Sends a request to rehydrate the canvas, handling auto-retry and status updates.

methods.name: setGatewayToken
methods.description: Stores a new gateway token in preferences.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Starts connection process to a specified gateway endpoint with optional authentication.

methods.name: connectWithAuth
methods.description: Handles the actual connection using endpoint and credentials, initiating session setup.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectAuth
methods.description: Resolves the authentication credentials used to connect to a gateway.

methods.name: acceptGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Accepts TLS trust prompt, saves fingerprint, and proceeds to connect.

methods.name: declineGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Declines TLS trust, resets prompt state.

methods.name: gatewayTlsProbeFailureMessage
methods.description: Returns a human-readable message for TLS probe failure reasons.

methods.name: hasRecordAudioPermission
methods.description: Checks if app has permission to record audio.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Initiates manual connection based on user-provided host and port.

methods.name: loadStoredRoleDeviceToken
methods.description: Loads stored device token for a given role from device auth store.

methods.name: maybeStartOperatorSessionAfterNodeConnect
methods.description: Attempts to start operator session after node connection, if conditions are met.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates current gateway connection and clears state.

methods.name: handleCanvasA2UIActionFromWebView
methods.description: Processes actions originating from the web-based UI, sending events or notifying failure.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is trusted for canvas actions.

methods.name: loadChat
methods.description: Loads a chat session by session key.

methods.name: refreshChat
methods.description: Refreshes current chat.

methods.name: refreshChatSessions
methods.description: Refreshes list of chat sessions, with optional limit.

methods.name: setChatThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets the AI response thinking level.

methods.name: switchChatSession
methods.description: Switches to a different chat session by key.

methods.name: abortChat
methods.description: Aborts current chat operation.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message with specified thinking level and attachments.

methods.name: sendChatAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a chat message and awaits acceptance confirmation.
